h1: AWS Cloud Practitioner Quiz & Practice Questions
subhead: Take a free practice quiz or point your phone at any AWS Cloud Practitioner question for an instant, explained answer — cloud concepts, security, and billing, without the guesswork.
metaTitle: AWS Cloud Practitioner Quiz & Practice Questions | Cambo
metaDescription: Free AWS Cloud Practitioner quiz and practice questions with instant, explained answers. Cloud concepts, security and compliance, core services, and billing.
whyItWorks: Cloud Practitioner questions usually describe a business scenario and ask which AWS service or pricing model fits best out of several plausible-sounding options — the exam is testing judgment, not memorized definitions. Cambo reads the exact scenario and explains which service applies and why, not just which letter is correct.

sampleQuestions.q: Which AWS pricing model lets you pay only for the compute capacity you actually use, with no upfront commitment?
sampleQuestions.a: On-Demand pricing — you pay for compute by the second or hour with no long-term commitment, ideal for unpredictable or short-term workloads.

sampleQuestions.q: A company wants durable, low-cost storage for infrequently accessed backup files, and retrieval times of several hours are acceptable. Which service is the BEST fit?
sampleQuestions.a: Amazon S3 Glacier — it's built for long-term archival storage at very low cost, trading slower retrieval times for a much lower price than S3 Standard.

sampleQuestions.q: Which AWS service lets a company run code in response to events without provisioning or managing servers?
sampleQuestions.a: AWS Lambda — it's a serverless compute service that runs your code in response to triggers, and you're only charged for the compute time it uses.

sampleQuestions.q: Under the AWS Shared Responsibility Model, who is responsible for patching the underlying hypervisor and physical infrastructure?
options: Both AWS and the customer equally
sampleQuestions.a: AWS — AWS handles security "of" the cloud (physical infrastructure, hypervisor, host OS), while the customer handles security "in" the cloud (their data, applications, and configurations).

sampleQuestions.q: Which AWS support plan is the minimum required to get a dedicated Technical Account Manager (TAM)?
sampleQuestions.a: Enterprise — a dedicated Technical Account Manager is a benefit of the Enterprise support plan, aimed at organizations running mission-critical workloads.

sampleQuestions.q: A startup wants to estimate the monthly cost of a proposed AWS architecture before deploying it. Which tool should they use?
sampleQuestions.a: AWS Pricing Calculator — it's designed to estimate costs for a planned architecture before you build it, unlike Cost Explorer and Budgets, which analyze costs already incurred.

faqs.q: How many questions are on the AWS Cloud Practitioner exam?
faqs.a: 65 questions total (50 scored, 15 unscored) to complete in 90 minutes.

faqs.q: What score do I need to pass?
faqs.a: 700 on a scaled range of 100 to 1,000.
Cloud Concepts (24%), Security and Compliance (30%), Cloud Technology and Services (34%), and Billing, Pricing, and Support (12%).

faqs.q: Is Cambo affiliated with Amazon Web Services?
faqs.a: No. Cambo is an independent study tool and isn't produced, endorsed, or affiliated with Amazon Web Services (AWS).

faqs.q: Are there any prerequisites for the Cloud Practitioner exam?
faqs.a: No formal prerequisites — AWS recommends around six months of exposure to AWS Cloud concepts, but anyone can register and sit for the exam.

faqs.q: How many times can I retake the exam?
faqs.a: There's no limit on attempts, but you must wait 14 calendar days after a failed attempt before retaking, and pay the exam fee again each time.
